newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens bourse OKs Michaniki, Kreka rights issues.
newsitem.headline: Athens bourse OKs Michaniki, Kreka rights issues.

text.p: The Athens stock exchange approved the planned rights issues of Michaniki and Kreka, it said on Thursday.
Kreka will issue 885,120 new common bearer shares at 1,000, seeking to raise 885 million drachmas. Rights will entitle shareholders to four new shares per 10 outstanding.
Construction firm Michaniki will tap the market for 11.2 billion drachmas with an issue of 3,398,630 common registered shares at 1,900 and 3,398,630 preferred non-voting registered shares at 1,400.
The terms will be two new common and two preferred for every 10 outstanding common or preferred shares. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
